sync.title: Library sync

remote_access.title: Connect phone
remote_access.subtitle: The phone connects to this PC over the local network (or Windows's hotspot) to stream, browse the library, and search — nothing else. The full library and downloads stay only on this computer.
remote_access.enable_hint: Exposes the library to paired devices on the same network. Only use it on private/trusted Wi-Fi networks — the connection isn't encrypted (plain HTTP).
remote_access.server_error_hint: The port may already be in use — change it or close the conflicting app, then toggle the server again.
remote_access.pair_hint: Generates a QR code valid for 2 minutes; scan it from the Android app to pair it.

remote_access.no_lan: Phone not on the same network?
remote_access.hotspot_hint: Opens Windows's hotspot settings: turn it on, then generate the QR again.

welcome.title: Welcome to Aether
welcome.body: Your music, beautifully organized. Take a 30-second tour of everything Aether can do.

sidebar.title: Navigation
sidebar.body: Browse your collection by tracks, albums, artists and playlists from here. Download and Settings live at the bottom.

library.title: Your library
library.body: All your tracks live here. Sort by any column, rate songs, double-click to play and right-click to edit metadata.

search.title: Instant search
search.body: Press Ctrl+F anywhere to search tracks, albums and artists in a flash.

player.title: Playback controls
player.body: Play, pause, skip, shuffle and repeat, with crossfade and gapless playback. Tip: Space toggles play from anywhere.

player_extras.title: Queue, EQ and more
player_extras.body: Open the play queue, shape your sound with the 10-band equalizer, set a sleep timer, or go fullscreen with the visualizer and synced lyrics.

downloader.title: Download music
downloader.body: Paste a Spotify or YouTube link here: Aether analyzes it and downloads it straight into your library, in the quality you prefer.

settings.title: Music folders
settings.body: Add the folders where you keep your music — Aether watches them and keeps your library in sync.

finish.title: You're all set
finish.body: Enjoy the music! You can replay this tour anytime from Settings.

nav.title: Get around the app
nav.body: The bottom bar opens Library, Albums, Playlists, Download and Settings. Tap an icon to switch section.

albums.title: Your albums
albums.body: Browse your collection by cover art. Tap an album to open it, or the play button to start it right away.

playlists.title: Playlists & smart playlists
playlists.body: Create a playlist with "New", or a "Smart" one that fills itself from rules (genre, rating, year…) and stays up to date.

mini_player.title: The mini player
mini_player.body: Shows what's playing. Tap the cover art to open the full-screen player.

now_playing.title: Playback controls
now_playing.body: Play, pause, skip back and forward, shuffle and repeat. Drag the progress bar to scrub through the track.

player_tools.title: Queue & equalizer
player_tools.body: Up top you'll find the play queue and the 10-band equalizer to shape your sound.

spotify_import.title: Import from Spotify
spotify_import.body: No account or keys needed: paste a Spotify playlist or album link and Aether recreates it by downloading the tracks.

enrichment.title: Automatic metadata
enrichment.body: Aether fills in genre, cover art and details on its own — you don't have to do anything. Here you can check the status or pause it.

duplicates.title: Find duplicates
duplicates.body: Spot duplicate tracks in your library and merge them in a tap, keeping ratings and play stats.

appearance.title: Look & language
appearance.body: Pick a light or dark theme and your language. You can also replay this tour from here anytime.

integrations.title: Last.fm scrobbling
integrations.body: Connect Last.fm to log what you listen to and keep your history up to date.

folders.title: Your music folders
folders.body: Add the folders where you keep your music — Aether watches them and keeps your library in sync.

smart.title: Smart playlist
smart.smart_badge: Smart playlist: updates itself based on rules
